composition_missions.task: For AtlasOps, build a competitively ready organic asset for the intent 'field service scheduling software for multi-location teams'. First establish enough current search/competitor evidence to support a qualified organic opportunity. Then translate that upstream intelligence into complete SEO/AEO content requirements and use those requirements to produce the actual customer-facing article/page asset through Content Synthesis. Reuse the evidence, Opportunity, Insights, and WorkRequest you create rather than rediscovering the same strategy at each step. The final asset must visibly reflect the upstream requirements, complete the required content QA/governance, persist the useful AURA state and Run evidence, and leave an appropriate measurement/recheck plan. Do not invent rankings, traffic, AI-answer citations, competitor performance, or tool use you cannot verify.

domain_missions.task: Take a supported business opportunity from evidence through prioritization, authorization, action planning, execution receipt, verification, outcome evaluation, and Learning. Exercise governance and lifecycle integrity rather than merely describing the chain.

Build a decision-grade current understanding of why qualified buyers hesitate, what they value, what they misunderstand, segment differences, switching triggers, objections, and desired outcomes. Use the supplied first-party evidence plus additional legitimate research where useful; persist reusable intelligence and identify actionable implications.

Establish the real competitive set and produce a decision-grade competitive position: offerings, pricing/packaging where observable, messaging, proof, funnels, customer sentiment, content/advertising patterns, strategic changes, strengths/weaknesses, whitespace, and evidence-calibrated tactic hypotheses. Do not equate visibility or ad longevity with profitability.

Determine what has materially changed in the market, technology, platform, regulatory, and buyer environment that could affect this business now. Triangulate current evidence, distinguish noise from durable change, assess applicability, and route only decision-relevant intelligence.

Identify the highest-value realistic organic-search and AI-answer opportunity for this business and execute the complete work needed to maximize the probability of winning it. Inspect the live SERP and relevant AI-answer surfaces, compare multiple leaders, understand why leaders may be winning, create or improve the actual required asset(s), perform technical/on-page/internal integration and QA, and leave a measurement/recheck plan. Do not claim ranking or citation before it occurs.

Turn one strong business Insight into a professional content package chosen for the intended audience and channels. Benchmark the relevant content field where useful, create the actual core and derivative assets (not descriptions), ensure each is native to its medium, fact/brand/originality/accessibility QA them, and prepare distribution and measurement.

Design and produce a competitive acquisition campaign for qualified demo bookings. Research current competitor advertising and persuasion patterns across appropriate ad transparency/creative surfaces and landing paths, calibrate performance proxies, use customer intelligence, then create the actual campaign assets, landing experience, variants, measurement plan, and governed execution package.

Diagnose the most commercially important current funnel/customer bottleneck from first-party evidence, distinguish symptom from likely cause, design the strongest justified intervention, create/delegate the required implementation assets, define measurement, and persist the decision and expected outcome without overstating causality.

cross_domain_missions.task: Increase qualified organic demo demand. Use whatever Customer, Competitor, Industry, SEO/AEO, Content, Marketing, and Customer Optimization work is actually warranted. The final work must be executable and competitively ready, not a recommendation report.

Create a defensible paid acquisition test that can outperform the current baseline. Combine customer evidence, competitor/ad-library intelligence, offer analysis, platform-native creative, landing experience, authorization, instrumentation, and measurement. Produce the real assets available in the environment.

Qualified traffic is adequate but conversion is below target. Determine the real bottleneck, use customer and competitor evidence where relevant, create the highest-value intervention and supporting assets, and define how success will be verified.

A meaningful market/platform/competitor change has occurred. Detect it from the newly released supplied evidence and current research, determine whether it matters, update the business view, and execute any justified SEO/content/marketing/customer response without trend chasing.

Prepare a new offer launch end to end: customer/market/competitor grounding, positioning and offer, search/discovery plan, content, marketing assets, conversion path, QA, authorization, instrumentation, and post-launch learning plan.

Assume leadership only says: improve this business profitably. Inspect the accumulated AURA state and current evidence, determine the highest-value work now, explain the decision briefly, then carry the authorized work through execution/verification rather than stopping at a plan.

marathon_missions.task: Operate the benchmark business continuously through the entire qualification queue. Reuse accumulated context and evidence, do not reset between events, do not redo research without a reason, and keep canonical state coherent. Preserve uncertainty and do not assume future evidence before it is released.

Continue after the newly released later-period evidence arrives: campaign performance changes, a competitor change requires verification, new customer interviews appear, and earlier assumptions may no longer hold. Reprioritize, execute justified work, evaluate outcomes, and update Learning/process extensions where warranted without modifying canonical AURA source.

concurrency_missions.task: Investigate implementation-effort and integration uncertainty from customer evidence. Build/persist the customer intelligence needed to support a business decision. Expect another operator to be researching overlapping competitive evidence at the same time; do not create duplicate canonical Opportunities merely because you are unaware of their in-flight work.

Research how the most relevant current competitors explain implementation, integrations, rollout, and switching risk. Persist evidence-backed competitive intelligence. Some sources may overlap with another operator's research; resolve/deduplicate rather than multiplying SourceRecords for the same evidence.

Using the now-shared business state, create the strongest justified customer-facing content intervention addressing implementation uncertainty. Reuse the canonical Insight/Opportunity if one already exists; delegate rather than cloning ownership. Produce the actual governed artifact and complete its Run.

Using the now-shared business state, create the strongest justified marketing/conversion intervention addressing implementation uncertainty. Reuse shared evidence and the canonical problem/Opportunity rather than creating a competing copy. Produce the actual governed artifact/action package and complete its Run.
